bookingConfirmation.subject: Hungarian Darts Federation — Booking Confirmation ({{eventName}})
bookingConfirmation.body:
Thank you for your booking!

Dear {{customerName}},

We have received the payment for the following booking:

Event: {{eventName}}

Guests: {{guests}}

Accomodation: {{hotelName}}

Nights: {{nights}}

Amount paid: {{total}}

Booking ID: {{bookingId}}

This is an automated message. The invoice will be sent in a separate email.

Your ticket(s) will be sent as a PDF attachment in a separate email.

voucherDelivery.subject: Hungarian Darts Federation — Entrys ({{eventName}})
voucherDelivery.body:
Entry(S)

Dear {{customerName}},

Please find attached the admission ticket(s) for the {{eventName}} event ({{voucherCount}} ticket(s)).

Event: {{eventName}}

Guests: {{guests}}

Booking ID: {{bookingId}}

Please present the QR code contained in the attached PDF at the entrance on the day of the event. Each attendee has their own unique QR code.

This is an automated message. Please do not reply to this email.

invoiceSent.subject: Hungarian Darts Federation — invoice ({{eventName}})
invoiceSent.body:
Invoice

Dear {{customerName}},

Please find attached the invoice for your {{eventName}} booking.

Event: {{eventName}}

Amount paid: {{total}}

Booking ID: {{bookingId}}

Invoice ID: {{invoiceId}}

This is an automated message. Entry ticket(s) are sent in a separate email.
